ad_info.reference_style: Lifestyle product ad with icon column and trust bar (pink beauty-supplement style)

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: glossy pink background, ultra-photorealistic woman in short fitted shorts, black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; soft daylight; believable real-life result.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pills and banners in fuchsia and deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside fuchsia circles, handwritten script accent with a small heart, soft pink petal shapes in the background.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold uppercase for headline and labels, Poppins Regular for supporting text, casual handwritten script for the emotional accent.

creative_objective: Expand the desire from glutes only to glutes, legs and hips, and prove it with a real woman seen from behind whose fuller glutes, hips and thighs fill the right half, while the bottle and three icons explain the benefit at a glance.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Stacked headline top-left with the giant last line. 2) The woman from behind on the right half. 3) The bottle at center-left. 4) Icon column, bottom bar and bottom pill.
art_direction.composition_style: Left column of text, icons and bottle; right half is the woman; two horizontal bands close the bottom across the width.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline block in the top-left 40% width; icon column hugs the left edge below the script line; bottle overlaps between icon column and woman; bottom bar and pill stacked with even gaps.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft diffused daylight on the woman, glossy studio highlight on the bottle, gentle drop shadows under the bottle and the bars, pink background with soft depth.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Pink background with soft petal shapes. Top-left: a deep magenta rounded pill with white uppercase text, under it a large white uppercase line and a giant deep-magenta uppercase last line. Under the headline, a handwritten fuchsia script phrase with a small heart. Left edge: a vertical column of 3 fuchsia circles with white line icons, each with a short uppercase label below. Center-left: the product bottle, large and upright, overlapping the area between the icons and the woman. Right half, from top to bottom: a real woman standing seen from behind, long dark hair, black crop top, short fitted shorts. Bottom: a wide deep-magenta rounded bar split in two cells by a thin vertical divider, each with a white icon and white uppercase text. Below it, a centered fuchsia rounded pill with a leaf icon at left, two-line text and an outline heart at right.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Pink #FF8CC0 to blush #FBE3EE background with very soft, large translucent petal shapes

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Expands the desire in three stacked lines

detected_visual_blocks.position: right half, top to bottom bar
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Ultra-realistic Latina woman from behind in short fitted shorts with visibly fuller glutes, hips and thighs

forbidden_additions: Any brand logo other than the label printed on the bottle
Price, discount, stars, ratings, testimonials or extra badges
CTA buttons beyond the existing bottom bar
Extra icons or benefit lines beyond the three in the column

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium supplement ad on a glossy pink background (bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 fading to pale blush #FBE3EE) with very soft, large translucent petal shapes. TOP-LEFT, stacked headline aligned left: a deep magenta (#B0105E) rounded pill with white bold uppercase text 'NO SOLO GLÚTEOS'; below it a big white bold uppercase line 'TAMBIÉN TUS' with a subtle shadow; below it the giant deep-magenta bold uppercase line 'PIERNAS Y CADERAS', the largest text in the ad. Under the headline, a fuchsia (#E6177F) handwritten script 'Tu mejor versión' with a small heart. LEFT EDGE, below the script, a vertical column of three fuchsia circles with thin white line icons (a rounded glutes silhouette, a leg silhouette, a leaf), each with a short bold uppercase label in deep magenta below it. CENTER-LEFT, large and upright, overlapping between the icon column and the woman: the product. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', the line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom; glossy highlight and a soft shadow. RIGHT HALF, from the top edge down to the bottom bar: an ultra-photorealistic real Latina woman in her mid-20s standing seen from behind, weight on one leg, long dark wavy hair down her back, black sports crop top, very short fitted sand-beige cotton shorts. Her glutes are clearly full, round and lifted, her hips wide and her thighs thick and toned, visibly voluminous yet natural and believable, not exaggerated; the glutes-and-thighs area fills about 60 percent of her half. Maximum realism: real skin texture with visible pores, fine natural creases, tiny moles, subtle natural skin tone variation, realistic fabric folds and stitching, soft natural daylight, shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens; no plastic or airbrushed skin; tasteful, non-explicit fitness-fashion styling. BOTTOM, full width: a wide deep-magenta rounded bar split by a thin white vertical divider into two cells; left cell a white shopping-bag icon with white bold uppercase 'PÍDELO HOY', right cell a white house icon with white bold uppercase 'TE LLEGA A CASA'. Below it, centered: a fuchsia rounded pill with a white leaf icon at the left, the two-line text in white (first line Poppins Regular, second line bold) and a white outline heart at the right. Clean, high-contrast, scroll-stopping. Include only these elements and texts.

Three fuchsia circles with white line icons in a left column
The real product bottle from the attached photo, large at center-left
Ultra-realistic woman from behind in very short fitted shorts on the right half, with visibly fuller glutes, hips and thighs

No prices, discounts, stars, ratings or testimonials
No cartoonish, exaggerated or surgical-looking body proportions; no nudity
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia), perfectly spelled with accents.
